assign.castAllCast: Every selected marcher is already in this transition.
assign.castHelp: Puts the selected marchers who aren't in this transition yet ({count}) into the vacant slots nearest to where they stand when it starts, one layer above any other move they have at these beats, so this one wins.
assign.castHelpFtl: Puts the selected marchers who aren't in this transition yet ({count}) into the lowest vacant slots, one layer above any other move they have at these beats. Follow the leader places marchers by their order on the trail, not by slot, so the nearest slot means nothing here.
assign.castNoVacancy: Selected marchers who need a slot: {count}. Vacant slots: {vacant}. Raise the slot count first.
assign.castNoneSelected: Select marchers to cast them into this transition.
assign.castStole: Cast on a higher layer, so these marchers now leave their other moves for these beats: {list}
assign.layerHelp: Where a marcher's moves overlap, the one on the higher layer wins, and the others are stolen for those beats.
assign.recastFtl: Follow the leader places marchers by their order on the trail, not by slot, so it can't be recast by nearest slot.
assign.recastHelp: Gives every marcher in this transition the slot nearest to where it starts, keeping its beats and layer. A later follow-the-leader move that inherits its order from this one will follow the new slot order.
assign.recastNoMembers: Nobody is in this transition yet.
assign.slotHelp: Type a vacant slot to move a marcher there, or an occupied one to trade places with its marcher.
assign.stolen: Stolen from beat {start} to {end} by a higher layer.
assign.stolenBy: Stolen from beat {start} to {end} by transition {transition} on a higher layer.
assign.title: Slots in transition {id}
assign.tooManySlots: Automatic casting handles up to {max} slots. Type each marcher's slot instead.

diagnostics.dFtlEmpty: Nobody founds this follow-the-leader move, so there's no trail: the marchers fill the shape from its far end.
diagnostics.dFtlNonFounding: This marcher joined or resumed a follow-the-leader move partway, so it isn't part of the trail's order and heads to its target on its own.
diagnostics.dOrderFallback: This move couldn't inherit an order from a single earlier move, so it uses slot order.
diagnostics.dRebase: This marcher joined or resumed this move partway, so its path was rebased to start where it was.
diagnostics.dVacant: Slot {slot} has no marcher assigned, so nobody goes to that place.
diagnostics.showNone: No diagnostics for the whole show.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

edit.bulgeHelp: From -0.5 to 0.5: 0 is straight and ±0.5 is a half circle. Larger arcs aren't supported, because they could carry a marcher farther from its target than where it started.
edit.ftlNeedsShape: Follow the leader follows a path, so it needs a destination shape. Pick a shape first.
edit.ftlNotBlock: Follow the leader can't end in a block. Pick a line, freehand, circle or box shape first.
edit.individualFtl: Follow the leader needs a shape. Change the path style first to use individual points.
edit.individualHelp: Each slot has its own point. Switching from a shape puts each point where the shape put that slot.
edit.noShapes: There are no shapes yet. Draw one to use it as a destination.
edit.noWaypoints: No waypoints: the trail runs straight onto the shape.
edit.orderInheritHelp: Follow the leader keeps the order the marchers had in their previous move.
edit.orderSlotHelp: Follow the leader orders the trail by slot number.
edit.shapeNoFtl: {shape}: follow the leader can't end in a block
edit.slotCountMin: At least {min}, because slot {slot} has a marcher assigned.
edit.slotCountPoints: New slots start at the last slot's point.
edit.title: Edit transition {id}
edit.waypointsHelp: Points the trail passes through before it reaches the shape, in field coordinates.

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.help: Shapes are formations in field coordinates, with no time. A transition moves its marchers into one. A new shape is drawn through the selected marchers where they stand at the selected page, or in the middle of the field when nobody is selected.
shapes.canvasHelp: The picked shape is drawn on the field. Drag a round handle to reshape it, or the square handle to move it. Each drag is saved as one change when you let go.
shapes.dragDropped: That drag wasn't saved, because another shape change was still being saved. Drag it again.
shapes.name: Name
shapes.usedHelp: Changes move every marcher heading to this shape.
shapes.kindHelp: Changing the kind redraws the shape in the area the old one covered. A box or circle becomes an open freehand path along its outline, so its two ends are different places.
shapes.kindInUse: Transitions {list} use this shape. Changing its kind spreads their slots over the new shape, so their marchers end in new places.
shapes.kindNoFtl: It can't become a block: transition {list} follows the leader into it, and a trail can't end on a block.
shapes.pointsHelp: Slots are spread evenly along the path, from the first point to the last.
shapes.pointsMin: A freehand path needs at least two points.
shapes.circleHelp: Slots are spread evenly around the circle from the start angle. Angles and directions are in field coordinates, measured from +x toward +y.
shapes.boxHelp: Slots are spread evenly around the outline, starting at the origin.
shapes.cells: {rows} × {cols} = {cells} places, filled row by row from the origin.
shapes.cellsNeeded: Transition {list} has {slots} slots, so the block needs at least {slots} places.
shapes.noPositions: None of the selected marchers is in the timeline yet, so there is nowhere to draw the shape through. Select marchers that are, or nobody to draw it in the middle of the field.
shapes.deleteInUse: It can't be deleted while transitions {list} use it. Give them another destination first.

span.foundingHelp: In this transition from its start, so its path starts from the marcher's position at the start of the transition.
span.holdHelp: Not moving: no move is active, so the marcher stays where it is.
span.joinHelp: Joined this transition after it started, so its path starts from where the marcher was when it joined.
span.resumeHelp: Back in this transition after another move took over, so its path starts from where the marcher was.

errors.assignmentDoesNotFit: That marcher's move doesn't fit the transition: it must stay inside the transition's range, and use a slot the transition has.
errors.assignmentOutsideTransition: A marcher's move must stay inside its transition. Adjust the transition's range, or the move's.
errors.assignmentOverlap: That marcher already has a move on the same layer at those beats. Put one of them on a different layer, or move it.
errors.blockTooSmall: The block doesn't have enough places for every slot. Add rows or columns, or use fewer slots.
errors.database: The change couldn't be saved, so nothing was changed. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.
errors.destinationInvalid: A destination isn't valid. Destinations must be finite points on the field.
errors.destinationShapeUnsuitable: That destination doesn't fit the transition. A follow-the-leader transition can't end on a block, and a block needs at least as many places as the transition has slots.
errors.followLeaderBlock: A follow-the-leader transition can't end on a block. Choose a line, curve, circle or box instead.
errors.followLeaderNeedsShape: A follow-the-leader transition needs a shape to follow.
errors.legacyConvertedTimeline: This file was converted to timelines by an earlier development build, which put several page moves in one timeline, so it can't be edited. Convert it again: open its backup (the file saved next to it before the conversion), or run convertPages('{ replace: true }') from the developer console.
errors.notReady: The timeline is still loading. Try again in a moment.
errors.numberOutOfRange: A number is out of range. Beats, layers, slot counts and positions must be whole or finite numbers within the allowed limits.
errors.pathParamsInvalid: That path setting isn't valid. An arc's bulge can be at most half the distance between its ends, and waypoints must be points on the field.
errors.shapeInvalid: That shape isn't valid. Its points must be on the field, a line needs two different end points, a freehand path needs some length, and a circle, box or block needs a positive size.
errors.shapeOrDestinations: A transition uses either a shape or one individual destination for every slot, never both and never fewer.
errors.slotOutOfRange: That slot doesn't exist. A transition's slots are numbered from 0 up to one less than its slot count.
errors.transitionSpansTimeline: A transition must span its whole timeline, starting and ending with it. Change the timeline's range instead, and its transitions move with it.
errors.unknown: The timeline couldn't make that change.
